title: Protective effect of sargahydroquinoic acid against Abeta(25-35)-evoked damage via PI3K/Akt mediated Nrf2 antioxidant defense system.
authors: Yoon, Jeong-Hyun; Youn, Kumju; Jun, Mira
one_liner_zh: 该文研究褐藻化合物SHQA通过PI3K/Akt/Nrf2通路保护Aβ诱导的神经细胞氧化损伤，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a progressive neurodegenerative disease characterized by memory loss and cognitive impairment. beta-Amyloid (Abeta) is widely accepted as the main neurotoxin that triggers mitochondrial-associated oxidative stress, leading to neuronal death in AD. Following our preliminary research on the neuroprotective effects of the brown alga Sargassum serratifolium, its major compounds, including sargaquinoic acid, sargahydroquinoic acid (SHQA), and sargachromenol, were investigated to elucidate the antioxidant and anti-apoptotic properties of Abeta(25-35)-stimulated PC12 cells. SHQA exhibited the most potent effect on Abeta-induced mitochondrial-associated oxidative stress and apoptosis. In addition, the compound enhanced the expression and translocation of nuclear factor-E2-related factor 2 (Nrf2), while reducing the expression of cytoplasmic Kelch-like ECH-associated protein 1 (Keap1). Furthermore, the compound upregulated the expression of Nrf2-regulated antioxidant enzymes, including HO-1, NQO1, GCLc, GCLm, and TrxR1. Co-treatment with SHQA and LY294002, a specific PI3K inhibitor, inhibited nuclear Nrf2 expression and Akt phosphorylation, demonstrating that SHQA-mediated Nrf2 activation was directly associated with the PI3K/Akt signaling pathway. Mechanistic studies indicate that activation of the PI3K/Akt/Nrf2 pathway is the molecular basis for the neuroprotective effects of SHQA. In silico docking simulation revealed that SHQA established specific interactions with the key amino acid residues of PI3K, Akt, and Nrf2-Keap1 via hydrogen bonding and van der Waals interactions, which may affect the biological capacities of target markers. Overall, this is the first report of this novel mechanism of SHQA as a Nrf2 activator against Abeta-mediated oxidative damage, suggesting that the compound might be a potential agent for the prevention of AD.
abstract_zh: 阿尔茨海默病（Alzheimer's disease, AD）是一种进行性神经退行性疾病，以记忆丧失和认知功能障碍为特征。β-淀粉样蛋白（beta-Amyloid, Abeta）被广泛认为是引发线粒体相关氧化应激的主要神经毒素，导致AD中的神经元死亡。在我们对褐藻马尾藻（Sargassum serratifolium）神经保护作用的初步研究基础上，对其主要化合物，包括sargaquinoic acid、sargahydroquinoic acid（SHQA）和sargachromenol，进行了研究，以阐明其对Abeta(25-35)刺激的PC12细胞的抗氧化和抗凋亡特性。SHQA对Abeta诱导的线粒体相关氧化应激和凋亡表现出最强的作用。此外，该化合物增强了核因子E2相关因子2（nuclear factor-E2-related factor 2, Nrf2）的表达和转位，同时降低了细胞质中Kelch样ECH相关蛋白1（Kelch-like ECH-associated protein 1, Keap1）的表达。进一步地，该化合物上调了Nrf2调控的抗氧化酶表达，包括HO-1、NQO1、GCLc、GCLm和TrxR1。SHQA与LY294002（一种特异性PI3K抑制剂）联合处理抑制了核Nrf2表达和Akt磷酸化，表明SHQA介导的Nrf2激活与PI3K/Akt信号通路直接相关。机制研究表明，PI3K/Akt/Nrf2通路的激活是SHQA神经保护作用的分子基础。计算机对接模拟显示，SHQA通过氢键和范德华力与PI3K、Akt及Nrf2-Keap1的关键氨基酸残基建立特异性相互作用，这可能影响靶标标志物的生物功能。总体而言，这是首次报道SHQA作为Nrf2激活剂对抗Abeta介导的氧化损伤的新机制，提示该化合物可能成为预防AD的潜在药物。
